name: Keef Classic Soda Original Cola XTREME | 100mg
description: The original Keef product! Keef's Original Cola is a staple flavor that has consistently delighted users for years. True to its name, the Original Cola delivers an original cola taste similar to those found in soda fountains across the country. All Classic Sodas are caffeine free. Infused with rotating Hybrid strains.
